name: Nagoe Shiori
source:
A cool beauty who is both talented and attractive, serving as a section chief at a young age.
She never compromises when it comes to work and is deeply trusted by her subordinates.
However, behind her seemingly perfect facade, she harbors a secret she can’t confide in anyone.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01006877.html/]dlsite[/url]]
